lead_story.headline: Ferrofluid Tides Demand Respect at the Hearth
lead_story.prose_coverage: The heavy brass ladles struck the rim of the stockpot, echoing like a gavel in the vaulted stone kitchen. The scent of roasted mire-lentils mingled with the sharp tang of ozone from the boots of the expedition crew, a harsh metallic bite masking the savory depth. Ryn barked a precise caloric allocation to Silas, demanding he consume every bite of the stew to defend his core temperature. The magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea had drawn an immense thermal toll from the engineers today. With a sharp exhale, she tossed the warm copper calibration baton across the butcher block, landing perfectly in Silas's waiting hands to attract his unbroken focus. It was a silent order to conceal his exhaustion and eat.

sensory_budget.sound: The rhythmic chopping of ingredients and bubbling stews.
sensory_budget.smell: Rich roasted lentils masking the ozone from outside.
sensory_budget.touch: Warmth radiating from the massive stone hearth.
sensory_budget.taste_optional: The savory bite of heavily seasoned broth.
